Save/attack rolls and damage/healing use pinned engine facts and fixed authoritative RNG. Mode choices, later-turn actions, target-local deadlines, exact trigger episodes and support teardown survive retry/recovery.

Ordinary casting range is not a perpetual leash. Apply only explicitly declared continuing distance/control limits; preserve complete affected roster and all required supporting actions/objects/form stats.

Time-span spells have current-source caster dismissal without action while caster is not Incapacitated; exact source-episode teardown and permitted scope must be materialized rather than requiring generic paid remove-effect action.

Same-spell overlapping applications do not combine; strongest applies, equal potency favors most recent, suppressed/inapplicable identities retain lawful deadlines. Different-effect defense/condition/AC/contribution order requires owner policy.

source_unknown_resolution_evidence.source_interpretation: Up to three targets within 30 feet gain 5 current and maximum HP for eight hours; each slot level above 2 adds 5 HP. Same-spell overlap uses the strongest, then the most recent equally potent effect.
material_qualifiers: Ongoing time-span dismissal requires the caster not be Incapacitated.
Effects of the same spell do not combine; equal potency uses the most recent while durations overlap.
Do not restore entry HP, erase intervening damage/healing, sum contributions, or substitute temporary HP.
Native health normalization, expiry, replacement and recovery are not established.
source_unknown_resolution_evidence.retained_source_residual: Exact removal or normalization of Aid's current-HP increase after intervening damage/healing, and strongest/equal overlap transition arithmetic, remain unspecified; neither clamp-only nor automatic subtraction is selected.

source_unknown_resolution_evidence.source_interpretation: Audible mode is a handbell for 10 seconds within 60 feet of the warded area; mental mode alerts within one mile of the area and wakes a sleeping caster.
material_qualifiers: Sound and ward lifetimes are distinct: 10 seconds versus eight hours.
The warded target is a door, window or area no larger than a 20-foot Cube; designated creatures are exempt.
A radius does not prove sound propagation, occlusion or public disclosure behavior.
Timed trigger, sound, private disclosure and recovery consumers remain unproved.

source_unknown_resolution_evidence.source_interpretation: A visible Tiny Beast attempts delivery on failed Charisma save; a nonzero Challenge Rating automatically succeeds. The caster supplies a visited location, descriptive recipient and at most 25 words. Travel is about 25 miles per 24 hours, or 50 if it can fly; duration gains 48 hours per slot level above 2.
material_qualifiers: About is approximate, not guaranteed pathfinding speed or arrival.
If it fails to reach the destination before expiry, the message is lost and the Beast returns to the casting location; no exact return duration is given.
Flight is the capability predicate; no instant relocation or additional agent is implied.
Chronology, control, disclosure and native recovery remain unproved.

source_unknown_resolution_evidence.source_interpretation: The spell binds a closed door, window, gate, container or hatch; nonmagical means cannot unlock it. The caster and creatures designated at casting can operate it; a password within five feet unlocks it for one minute.
material_qualifiers: The source gives no legacy +10 difficulty bonus, lock-specific damage bonus or object invulnerability.
Destruction is distinct from unlocking; generic Asset destruction does not settle this effect's source-specific consequence.
Do not infer which remainder retains the effect or that partial destruction grants access.
Native object/effect termination, rebinding and access proof remain open.
source_unknown_resolution_evidence.retained_source_residual: The spell body does not specify termination/rebinding when its object is destroyed or becomes a meaningful remainder, nor an exact source-specific access outcome for partial destruction.

source_unknown_resolution_evidence.source_interpretation: Before finishing a Long Rest, each Augury cast after the first adds cumulative 25-percent no-answer risk; ordinal casts one through five derive to 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100 percent. The course is within the next 30 minutes.
material_qualifiers: Probability saturates at certainty; this is not an added cast-count cap or cast prohibition.
Zero on the first casting concerns this recast risk only; the GM still chooses the omen.
Changed circumstances such as other spells are not accounted for, so the omen is not a guaranteed prediction.
The adjacent Omens table is not newly qualified by this resolution; count/reset, fixed-RNG, omen and recovery consumers remain unproved.

source_unknown_resolution_evidence.source_interpretation: Two or more equal raw d8 faces permit a leap to a different chosen target within 30 feet of the previous target, followed by a fresh attack and damage roll. Base slot allows one leap; maximum leaps equal slot level, and a creature may be targeted only once per casting.
material_qualifiers: A permitted leap is conditional; slot level alone does not guarantee a complete chain.
Do not substitute summed/mitigated damage for raw d8 equality or roll damage on a miss.
Use actual target identity, not target name.
The separate six-damage-type-member residual remains open; native attack/dice/history/cost/recovery proof is not established.

source_unknown_resolution_evidence.source_interpretation: A failed Wisdom save by a visible creature within 60 feet imposes exactly one of five named commands on its next turn; each slot level above 1 adds one target. Approach ends its turn if it moves within 5 feet of the caster.
material_qualifiers: Drop ends after dropping whatever is held; Flee spends the turn moving away by the fastest available means; Grovel imposes Prone then ends the turn.
Halt removes movement, action and Bonus Action; the source does not expressly prohibit Reactions.
The Approach stopping clause is movement-conditioned; do not infer an already-inside starting-position rule.
No legacy language/Undead/harmful-command exclusions or free-form command are added; native turn/movement/drop/Prone/retry/expiry proof remains open.

source_unknown_resolution_evidence.source_interpretation: Continual Flame creates object-bound 20-foot Bright Light plus 20 additional feet of Dim Light. Darkness overlap dispels the other spell when that light was created by a spell of level 2 or lower; a level-3-or-higher slot gives this casting that higher level.
material_qualifiers: Continual Flame creates no heat/fuel and may be covered/hidden but not smothered/quenched.
The dispel rule is limited to the exact spell-origin/slot-level threshold and dispels the other spell.
No blanket magical-darkness immunity, universal darkness-disruption or general magical-light rule follows.
Typed origin/slot level, overlap, projection, Effect teardown and native proof remain future.

source_unknown_resolution_evidence.source_interpretation: Range is 30 feet. The spell creates/destroys up to 10 gallons per slot level in an open container, or uses rain/fog in a Cube whose edge begins at 30 feet and increases by 5 feet per slot level above 1.
material_qualifiers: Up to permits a lesser amount; sealed containers are not the stated open-container target.
Cube edge is neither radius nor additive volume; fog is not gallon-quantified.
Rain extinguishes exposed flames.
Asset capacity does not specify this spell's exact insufficient-capacity result; no overflow, spill, truncation, capacity expansion or bypass is selected.
Native water/material extent, placement and environmental consequences remain unproved.
source_unknown_resolution_evidence.retained_source_residual: The source gives no explicit result for creating more water than an eligible open container can hold; capacity limits do not supply the spell-specific insufficient-capacity outcome.

source_unknown_resolution_evidence.source_interpretation: Range is 120 feet; up to four hovering torch-size lights can instead be combined into one vaguely humanlike Medium form. Each light has 10-foot Dim Light. Bonus Action movement is at most 60 feet to a space within range; each must be within 20 feet of another same-casting light.
material_qualifiers: A light expressly vanishes if it exceeds spell range.
The 20-foot link predicate is distinct from that explicit vanishing trigger; do not infer link-failure disappearance.
The form is not an Actor/statblock or extra agent.
The common movable-effect rule does not remove an express ongoing range condition; geometry, form-transition and recovery proof remain future.

source_unknown_resolution_evidence.source_interpretation: Range is 60 feet; point mode is a 15-foot-radius Sphere, while an object not worn/carried creates a 15-foot Emanation. Any overlap with Bright/Dim Light from a level-2-or-lower spell dispels that other spell.
material_qualifiers: Darkvision cannot see through Darkness; nonmagical light cannot illuminate it.
Opaque cover blocks object-mode Darkness without ending its spell lifetime.
The casting's actual level follows the slot used; no blanket magical-light suppression or self-dispel is inferred.
Geometry, perception, origin-level and teardown consumers/native recovery remain unproved.

source_unknown_resolution_evidence.source_interpretation: Senses listed locations within 30 feet and active Hallow presence/location. Barriers are 1 foot of stone, dirt or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
material_qualifiers: Source gives no numeric lead thickness; do not restore legacy 3-foot wood or omit dirt.
The spell is not alignment/morality detection.
The separate supernatural-type-members residual is not selected or closed here.
Effective type/Mask/Hallow queries and recipient-scoped disclosure remain future proof.
